screens.title: Profil & Karakter Pembelajar (Langkah 1 dari 3: Profil Diri)
screens.purpose: First step of a 3-step post-signup onboarding wizard. It collects the learner's nickname, learner status and the language style Mika answers in, so AI explanations are tailored. It sits after email verification (or after Google signup) and before Beranda. The login mockup's demo simulator confirms that a logged-in user with incomplete onboarding is redirected to /onboarding.
screens.top_bar: Sticky custom header, not a Material TopAppBar. Row 1: HeyMika logo image on the left, and on the right a pill with a pulsing star icon reading 'VOL. 1 • ONBOARDING' (light blue bg, blue text, uppercase). Row 2: a check-circle plus 'Langkah 1 dari 3: Profil Diri' on the left and '33%' on the right in blue. Row 3: a 33% gradient progress bar (blue to #2995FF). Row 4: '🐾 Siap temani belajarmu' on the left and '⚡ +150 XP saat selesai' in orange on the right. There is no back icon in the header; back lives in the sticky bottom bar.
sections: 1. Sticky header: logo, the 'VOL. 1 • ONBOARDING' pill, step label 'Langkah 1 dari 3: Profil Diri', 33% progress bar, and the micro row 'Siap temani belajarmu' / '+150 XP saat selesai'.

2. Mascot greeting card (white to #F2F8FF gradient, rounded 2xl). A 'TEMAN SETIA ★' orange corner ribbon sits top-right. Left: Mika waving with a pencil, horizontally mirrored. Right: a speech box labelled 'SAPAAN MIKA' with a chat icon, the quote '"Halo calon juara! Siapa nama panggilan kerenmu? Biar Mika bisa sapa kamu pas belajar!"' and the tip 'Tips: Belajar rutin 15–30 menit sehari lebih awet nempel di otak!'. Below a divider are two micro badges: '🌱 100% Ramah Pemula' (blue) and '⏰ 24/7 Tanya Mika' (orange).

3. Form card. Step chip '📋 LANGKAH 01 DARI 03' (wraps badly in the PNG), H1 'Profil & Karakter Pembelajar', and the subtitle 'Beri tahu Mika nama & statusmu agar gaya penjelasan AI pas dengan kemampuanmu.'
3a. Field 'Nama Panggilan Kamu *' with the right-aligned hint 'Disapa di dashboard'. Text input with a leading person icon, placeholder 'Contoh: Sasha / Kiki', example value 'Sasha Pratama'.

3b. 'Status Pembelajar Saat Ini *' with the right hint 'Pilih salah satu' (blue). A 2x2 radio grid of option cards, each with an emoji icon tile, a title and a subtitle: 🏛️ Mahasiswa / 'Kuliah, Tugas, Skripsi' (selected by default: solid blue fill, white text, white check badge top-right); 🎒 Siswa SMA / SMK / 'SNBT, UTBK, Ujian'; 🚀 Pembelajar Mandiri / 'Otodidak, Sertifikasi'; 💼 Profesional Karier / 'Upskilling & Kerja'.
3c. 'Gaya Bahasa Respon Mika *'. A 3-segment pill selector in a light blue track: 🇮🇩 Indonesia (active: white pill, blue text), 🇺🇸 English, 💬 Gaul / Santai.

4. Mini mission banner (HTML only; hidden behind the sticky footer in the PNG): a 💡 blue circle with 'Misi Otomatis Mika: Ringkasan materi, kuis harian kilat, & peta konsep akan disesuaikan dengan profil ini!'
5. Sticky bottom action bar: a square back button with a chevron (aria 'Kembali ke langkah sebelumnya') and the full-width primary CTA 'LANJUT KE TARGET & TOPIK →' (uppercase, blue, glow shadow).

DESIGN.md deviation: uses Nunito plus Plus Jakarta Sans instead of Nunito Sans. Cards use 1.5–2px light #E2EEFA borders with soft blur shadows, not 3px navy #082A52 borders with a 6px hard orange offset shadow. The CTA uses a blurred glow shadow instead of the 4px #005FC4 press shadow. The speech box has no 3px navy border and no tail. Emojis are used as icons where the other screens use Material Symbols.
The CTA is uppercase with letter spacing, unlike the sentence-case CTAs on the other auth screens.
The nickname overlaps the register screen's 'Nama Lengkap' field, whose hint reads 'Nama panggilan belajarmu'. Prefill one from the other.
'Gaya Bahasa Respon Mika' should set the AI response language/tone. It is unclear whether it also changes the app UI locale.

screens.title: Selamat datang kembali
screens.purpose: Sign-in screen for returning users: Google SSO or email and password, with 'remember me', forgot password and a link to registration. It is the entry point for logged-out users and routes on account state: unverified goes to verify email, onboarding incomplete goes to onboarding, otherwise Beranda.
screens.top_bar: No app bar and no back button; this is the root of the auth graph. Branding sits inside the card: a 'TEMAN BELAJARMU' pill (badge-cyan bg, filled auto_awesome sparkle icon, uppercase) on the left and a 'VOL. 1 • EDISI BELAJAR' pill (surface-container bg, muted text) on the right.
sections: 0. Canvas: #F8FCFF background with a #d6e3ff radial halftone dot grid (20px) and faint decorative stars. A cyan circle decoration peeks from the card's top-right corner.
1. Main comic card: white, 28px radius, hard orange 6px/6px #FF8A00 offset shadow, 20px padding. Width max 420dp with a 16dp margin.
2. Brand pill row: 'TEMAN BELAJARMU' and 'VOL. 1 • EDISI BELAJAR'.

3. Mascot duo: a 96dp circular avatar (surface-container-high bg) of Mika waving, and a speech bubble with a left-pointing tail: bold 'Ayo belajar bareng! 🐾' and caption 'Mika sudah siapkan kuis seru!'.
4. Title block: H1 'Selamat datang kembali' (headline-lg-mobile, 26sp/800) and subtitle 'Lanjutkan petualangan belajarmu bersama Mika' (text-muted).
5. Google button 'Lanjutkan dengan Google' with the multicolor G logo: white, 0 3px 0 #D8DDF4 bottom shadow, translates down on press.
6. Labelled divider: 'atau masuk dengan email'.
7. Inline alert box (hidden by default) between the divider and the form. Error variant: danger-bg, error icon, title and description. Info variant: badge-cyan bg, info icon.

8. Form: label 'Email', input with a leading mail icon, placeholder 'nama@email.com', example 'pelajar@heymika.id'. Label 'Kata Sandi', input with a leading lock icon, placeholder 'Masukkan kata sandi', and a trailing visibility toggle (visibility / visibility_off).
9. Row: checkbox 'Ingat saya' (checked by default) on the left, link 'Lupa password?' in primary blue on the right.
10. Primary CTA 'Masuk Sekarang →': primary #005ab5, 0 4px 0 #00458e shadow, headline-sm label, swaps to a spinner while loading.
11. Prompt 'Belum punya akun? Daftar sekarang' (link bold primary).

12. 'Uji Status Akun (Demo)' panel with a science icon and 'Ketuk chip:' plus four chips: '1. Belum Verifikasi' (orange dot), '2. Onboarding' (sky dot), '3. Sudah Siap (Masuk)' (green dot), '4. Sandi Salah' (red dot). This is a prototype-only control.
13. Legal footer: 'Dengan masuk, kamu menyetujui Ketentuan Layanan dan Kebijakan Privasi HeyMika.' with underlined links.
14. Toast (bottom-center, inverse-surface #113059, rounded 2xl, leading icon in brand-yellow): e.g. 'Berhasil masuk! Menyiapkan materi belajar Mika...'.

screens.title: Mulai belajar bersama Mika

screens.top_bar: No Material app bar. A row with the HeyMika logo image on the left and, on the right, a badge-cyan pill with a back chevron (arrow_back_ios_new) labelled 'DAFTAR AKUN BARU'. In the HTML it is a non-interactive div, but it reads as a back-to-login control.

2. 3. Main registration card (white, rounded 2xl, shadow-md). H1 'Mulai belajar bersama Mika', subtitle 'Daftar akunmu sekarang dan rasakan serunya belajar dengan panduan AI ramah 24/7.'

notes: This screen deviates the most from DESIGN.md. No component has a 3px navy border or an orange hard shadow; everything uses soft shadow-sm/md. The CTA uses #0072e3 with shadow-md instead of #0075E8 with a 4px #005FC4 press shadow. Inputs use a white fill with shadow-sm and no 2px #D8DDF4 border. The Google button is tinted-filled instead of white with a 2px navy border.
The 'DAFTAR AKUN BARU' pill shows a back chevron but is a non-clickable div in the HTML. Decide whether it is the back affordance; recommend a clickable back pill pointing to login.
The 'Nama Lengkap' label conflicts with the hint 'Nama panggilan belajarmu' and with the onboarding nickname field. Clarify whether this is a full name or a nickname.

The password policy differs from reset_password_heymika_mobile: here there are 3 rules (digit OR symbol), there 4 separate rules (digit AND symbol). Strength labels also differ (Lemah/Cukup/Kuat/Sangat Kuat! vs Sangat Lemah/Sedang/Kuat ✨/Sangat Kuat! 🛡️). Unify into a single PasswordPolicy in :core domain.
The 'Simulasi Navigasi Alur / Dev Preview' panel and the '/verify-email' code chip are prototype artefacts; drop them.
Required asterisks use ribbon-red #EF3E36, while DESIGN.md reserves ribbon-red for character touches and danger #BC2535 for errors. Prefer danger for required markers, or keep it as a brand choice.

screens.title: Buat password baru (Langkah 2 dari 2)
screens.purpose: Step 2 of password recovery. The screen opens from the emailed reset link (token). The user sets and confirms a new password under a strength policy while a token expiry countdown runs. It has three states: active form, expired or invalid token, and success. Saving revokes all other sessions.

Colors use Tailwind defaults (amber/emerald/purple/slate/red) instead of the DESIGN tokens. Icons are emoji instead of a consistent icon set. The Mika quote has no speech bubble with a tail. Checkboxes are 16px with slate borders instead of 20px with 2px navy.
Hero primary color is #0075E8 (brand blue) here, while the other three screens use the M3 token primary #005ab5. Pick one.
The 'Tanya Mika' bottom tab uses a 🐾 emoji here, smart_toy in the notification screen and chat_bubble in profil. Pick one icon.
Fake iOS status bar and home indicator in the HTML are mock chrome; drop them.
The task checkbox and the CTA are two separate interactions: the checkbox marks done manually, the CTA starts the activity.
'3 tugas paling penting' is styled as a link; decide whether it scrolls to the task list or navigates.
Biologi progress at 40% is drawn orange, which suggests a color rule for low progress (<50%?).

screens.mascot_usage: Largest mascot moment of the four screens: a 144dp circular Mika illustration that changes per state (imageAlt describes six poses: confused with an upside-down map; guarding a padlock; yawning with an hourglass and shield; holding unplugged antenna cables under a rain cloud; engineer hardhat with wrench; holding a gold star trophy), plus a 'nyaa~' sticker and a speech bubble with Mika's first-person quote and a directional tail.
notes: This is a design catalog, not a user-facing page. The state pills, catalog list, 'ALL SYSTEMS OPERATIONAL' ribbon, version tag and principles card are showcase chrome. In the app, build the reusable MikaErrorState composable driven by AppError (full-screen and inline variants), and optionally keep this catalog as a debug-only gallery.

In the PNG the mascot circle shows a screenshot of an older phone UI ('System Error / Oops! We've lost our way') with Mika inside it, not a clean mascot cut-out. Proper per-state mascot assets are needed. The 'nyaa~' sticker is clipped by the circle's overflow.

Deviates from DESIGN.md: no 3px navy ink border or orange offset shadow on the main card (shadow-xl blur instead), and the speech bubble has no 3px navy border (DESIGN requires bordered bubbles with a bordered tail). The 403 pill uses brown secondary #914c00. Otherwise uses token colors and Material Symbols.
'Mode Offline (PWA Cache)' and '404 / URL' are web concepts. On Android, Offline means the Room cache, and 404 means a deleted material or an invalid deep link.
The quota value here (50 prompts/day, free tier) conflicts with notifications (100 tokens/day) and Profil (unlimited chat on Pro).

No bottom nav: treat error states as full-screen overlays or destinations without the nav, or as inline content inside tab screens. Decide per state (e.g. Offline is better as a banner plus inline state, not a separate screen).
'Lapor Bug' needs a destination (bottom sheet form, or mailto) beyond a toast.

screens.mascot_usage: Mika appears in four places. A 64dp avatar with a '★ AI' badge fronts the 'Tips Mika Senpai' banner with a quoted tip. A 40dp Mika stamp thumbnail sits inside each active card's highlight box (the archived card uses a 📚 emoji instead). The Mika face forms the raised center 'Tanya Mika' bottom-nav button. The copy also carries Mika's voice ('Tantangan Mika Hari Ini', 'Sugoi! 🔥').
notes: PNG and HTML match closely. The only differences: the PNG clips the grid/list toggle at the right edge of the filter row, which needs a horizontal scroll or a tighter layout; the HTML has no visible status bar.

Design-system deviations: borders are 2px or 2.5px (DESIGN.md says 3px navy). The card shadow is navy '0 4px 0 #082a52', but DESIGN.md specifies an orange 6px 6px 0 #FF8A00 offset on mobile. Fonts are 'Nunito' plus 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for the H1 instead of Nunito Sans only. Canvas color is #F5F9FD/#EFF7FF instead of canvas-bg #F8FCFF. Button shadows #00509E and #D06D00 differ from the spec's #005FC4. Buttons are about 40dp tall, not 56dp.

Category colors (teal, emerald, rose, slate) are not palette tokens. The DESIGN.md 'Subject Tags' rule (light tint plus saturated ink) supports the idea, but a WorkspaceCategory color map is needed in the theme.
Emojis serve as icons in many places (📐💻🌊🔬🌸⚗️📄🎯📈). Decide whether to keep emoji or switch to vector icons.
The highlight box is heterogeneous per card (different label, value wording and badge per card). This suggests a server/AI-provided {label, value, badge} rather than one fixed metric.
The meaning of the avatar initials stack ('PD', 'AI', 'C+', 'Tre', '漢', '文') is unclear: collaborators, sources or tags. The HTML comment says 'Collaborators / AI tag'.
The bottom nav labels this tab 'Materimu', while tambah_materi_baru calls it 'Materiku' and uses a different 4-tab set. One canonical nav is needed.
The red notification dot uses Tailwind red-500, not ribbon-red or danger.
The whole card is pressable (active:scale) in addition to the 'Buka Deck' link.

screens.title: Detail Materi
screens.purpose: Workspace detail page. It shows the course metadata and exam countdown, counts of sources, flashcards and quizzes, and a 'new material' sync banner. Tabs switch between AI Summary, Sources, Flashcards and Quizzes. The Ringkasan AI tab (the only one designed) shows Mika's unified structured summary: key concepts, a visual tree diagram, a complexity cheatsheet table, exam readiness, and an inline 'ask Mika' chat card.
screens.top_bar: Fixed 64dp translucent white bar with a soft shadow (no navy border). Left: back arrow (history.back), small HeyMika logo, title 'Detail Materi' (headline-sm, truncate). Right: a 'Mika Bantuan' round button with the Material Symbol chat_spark (primary, surface-container-low), then a 32dp profile avatar. In the PNG the chat_spark ligature fails and renders as overlapping garbled glyphs. Below the bar is a second row with a pill '← Materimu' breadcrumb/back button on the left and two 40dp round icon buttons on the right: bookmark ('Simpan Workspace') and more_horiz ('Menu Opsi').
sections: 1. Breadcrumb row: '← Materimu' pill, bookmark icon button, more_horiz icon button.

2. Workspace header card (white, 16px radius, soft shadow-md, decorative faint 'terminal' icon circle at top-right): chips 'CS201' (surface-container-high), 'Ilmu Komputer' and 'Semester 3' (surface-container-low, muted text). Then an exam countdown pill (secondary-fixed peach, alarm icon): 'UAS: 14 Juli 2025 (Tersisa 18 Hari)'. Then the H2 'Struktur Data & Algoritma' (24px/800) with an 'Edit Judul' pencil icon button.
3. Description (body-sm): 'Kumpulan modul kuliah semester 3, ringkasan pohon biner, graf traversal, dan latihan soal persiapan UAS.'
4. 2x2 metric tiles: '📄 6 Dokumen / Sumber Belajar', '🎴 42 Flashcard / Siap Diulang', '📝 3 Paket Kuis / Uji Kemampuan', '⚡ AI Synced / Versi 2.1' (caption in primary bold).

5. Action buttons: a full-width primary 'Belajar bersama Mika ✨' (56dp, primary #005ab5, yellow sparkle, soft shadow), then a tonal 'Tambah Materi Sumber' with an add_circle icon (48dp, surface-container-low, primary text).

6. Sync notification banner (secondary-fixed peach, 16px radius): orange sync icon tile, 'Materi baru ditambahkan!', filename 'Catatan_Kuliah_Graph_BFS_DFS.docx' (truncate), and a small white 'Sinkronkan Sekarang →' button.

7. Horizontal scrollable pill tabs: 'Ringkasan AI' (active, primary, auto_stories icon), 'Sumber Materi (6)' (folder), 'Flashcard (42)' (style), 'Kuis Interaktif (3)' (quiz). The PNG clips at the third tab.

8. [Tab Ringkasan AI] Summary header card: auto_awesome icon tile (tertiary-fixed), 'Rangkuman Terpadu AI Mika', 'v2.1 • Diperbarui 2 jam lalu', 'Salin Catatan' copy and bookmark_border icon buttons. Inner row: green verified icon, 'Disintesis dari 4 dokumen valid', and a '⟳ Regenerate' text button.

9. Section 'Poin Kunci & Intuisi' (lightbulb icon) with a cyan '4 Konsep Utama' badge. Four concept cards (white, soft shadow), each a colored dot, title, tag chip and rich body with inline code chips. The cards: 'Binary Search Tree (BST)' [O(log n)]; 'BFS vs DFS pada Graf' [Antrean vs Tumpukan]; 'Dynamic Programming (DP)' [Sub-masalah]; 'Kompleksitas Amortisasi' [Dijkstra Heap]. Inline code chips are blue for good complexities and red for O(n) worst case. Bold terms appear in the body (Queue FIFO, Stack LIFO / Rekursi, Optimal Substructure, Overlapping Subproblems).

10. 'Tree Traversal' card (account_tree icon, cyan 'Manga Visual Note' badge). An SVG binary tree on canvas-bg: root A (filled primary, labeled 'Root'), B and C (tinted with a primary stroke), D, E and F (white with a muted stroke). Three traversal rows on surface-container-low: 'Preorder (Node - Left - Right)' / 'Kunjungi Awal': A➔B➔D➔E➔C➔F; 'Inorder (Left - Node - Right)' / 'Urutan BST': D➔B➔E➔A➔C➔F; 'Postorder (Left - Right - Node)' / 'Evaluasi Dasar': D➔E➔B➔F➔C➔A. Each row's title is colored primary, secondary or tertiary.

11. 'Cheatsheet Kompleksitas' (table_chart icon) with the muted label 'Ringkasan Ujian'. A 4-column table card with header Algoritma | Avg Time | Worst | Space. Rows: BST O(log n) | O(n) red | O(h); AVL Tree O(log n) | O(log n) | O(n); BFS Graf O(V + E) | O(V + E) | O(V); DFS Graf O(V + E) | O(V + E) | O(V); DP Tabular O(n) | O(n) | O(1) green.

12. 'Kesiapan Ujian UAS' card (verified_user icon) with a '74%' peach pill. A two-segment progress bar (50% primary plus 24% orange). Breakdown rows each have a thin bar: 'Pohon Biner & Traversal' 90% Siap (success green), 'Graph Traversal (BFS & DFS)' 60% Butuh Review (orange), 'Dynamic Programming' 45% Perlu Latihan (error red).

13. Mika companion card: 80dp Mika avatar tile and a speech bubble (surface-container-low, rounded-bl-sm, no tail border): 'Hai! Semangat belajar Struktur Data! Mau bahas bagian Tree Traversal sekarang? 🐾'. Below are quick prompt pills '💡 Jelaskan DFS vs BFS' (primary text) and '⚡ Buatkan 5 soal pohon biner' (secondary text), then a chat input 'Tanya Mika seputar materi...' (chat_bubble_outline icon) with a 48dp primary send button.

screens.mascot_usage: The 'Asisten Belajar Mika' card has an 80dp Mika avatar with a 'Mika ✨' tag and a speech bubble with a tail. Mika's message changes per state: reassurance while running, celebration on success, apology on failure. Mika also provides a topic-relevant study tip while the user waits. The copy promises a Mika 'ping' when the job finishes.
notes: This is the closest to the comic style of the four, together with materimu: navy borders and a hard shadow. It still deviates: borders are 2px, not 3px, and the shadow is navy '0 4px 0 #082A52' rather than the orange 6px 6px offset. Font is Nunito plus Kalam (Kalam is allowed by DESIGN.md as a comic accent). Greens and reds are Tailwind emerald/rose (#10B981, rose-600), not success #167549 and danger #BC2535. The speech bubble border is 1px slate, not 3px navy.

PNG vs HTML: the PNG shows a fake iOS status bar (drop it). The breadcrumb wraps badly ('BIOLOGI / SEL', '#JOB-2025- / 089X'), so use a single line with ellipsis. The '⚡ Sedang Diproses' text overflows its pill. The 'ASISTEN BELAJAR MIKA' pill text is clipped. 'Sisa ~45 detik' wraps outside its pill. The step 3 title wraps under the badge. Compose layouts must handle long Indonesian strings (avoid fixed-height pills).
The bottom 'DEMO SIMULATOR STATUS' bar is a mockup control. Do not ship it, but its three buttons define the required RUNNING / SUCCESS / FAILED states.
Do not ship the 'Terminal Log Teknis' console to end users; it exposes internal endpoint and embedding details. Hide it behind a debug build flag or remove it.

Real-time updates need a transport (SSE/WebSocket, polling with backoff, or FCM push) and must survive leaving the screen: a WorkManager or foreground notification with an optional 'Ding' sound and a deep link back to this screen. The current domain (Material, GeneratedContent) has no Job or Step model.
Step descriptions contain dynamic counts (pages, words, diagrams). The backend must return them per step, or the client builds them from templates.
'Kuota Aman' (quota not consumed on failure) and 'Kuota akan tetap utuh' (on cancel) are business rules the backend must honor.

notes: This is the screen closest to DESIGN.md (navy ink borders, orange hard shadows, speech bubble with tail), but the values drift: borders are 2-2.5px instead of 3px, shadows are 3.5-5px instead of 6px on mobile, task cards use a navy (#082A52) hard shadow instead of orange, and buttons use a diagonal navy offset with x/y press translation instead of the spec's 4px bottom shadow (#005FC4) with a 2px downward press.
Speech bubble border is 2px instead of 3px. The bubble tail is implemented as a rotated square; in Compose it can be a custom Shape.
'Ubah Rencana' uses an add_circle icon, which is semantically wrong for editing. Use edit or tune.
The day strip overflows at phone width in the PNG ('HARI INI' wraps, '14' and '30/45m' clipped, MIN 18 cut off). Use a LazyRow with fixed-width chips, or shrink the today label to 'Kini'.
The logo image plus the 'HeyMika' text again duplicates the wordmark.
The bottom nav here is 5 tabs (Beranda, Materi, Rencana, Kuis, Profil). This differs from daftar_flashcard (4 tabs) and statistik (Beranda, Materi, Kuis, Tanya Mika, Profil).
'Level Memori: 45%' is shown in success green even though 45% is low, so the color semantics are inconsistent.
Dates are hardcoded to May 2025 and the WIB timezone. Use the device locale and timezone.
The emoji in content ('🐾', '🔥', '🔒') should be icons or string resources.

Tasks reference other features (mistake bank, flashcards, quizzes), so the planner needs cross-feature navigation contracts. If it lives in a dynamic feature module, route through the FeatureEntry / navigation layer in :core.

screens.mascot_usage: Mika as 'Tutor AI' honesty narrator: 56dp avatar with a 'TUTOR AI' badge explaining that mastery is measured by unaided accuracy. Mika is also referenced in the 'Bahas Konsep dengan Mika' action and the floating Ask Mika bar (🐱 placeholder avatar, should be the real Mika asset).
notes: The PNG is a broken render. This HTML's Tailwind config defines only brand.* colors and no typography or semantic tokens, so classes like bg-primary, bg-surface, text-danger, bg-secondary-container and font-headline-* do nothing. As a result the PNG shows buttons as plain text, chips without fills, uniform text sizes, and chart bars with only the sky 'Catatan' segment floating. Here the HTML semantic classes plus DESIGN.md should be treated as the intended design. The PNG is only reliable for layout and order.

DESIGN.md deviation: no 3px navy borders or orange hard shadows anywhere; it uses soft shadow-sm/md. The only hard shadows are 'shadow-comic-orange'/'shadow-comic-blue' (4px bottom) on 'Drill Topik Ini', 'Genjot Kuis' and 'Buat Kuis Baru'. The Mika card is not a speech bubble.
Web/iOS artifacts to drop: the fake iOS status bar (09:41), the home-indicator bar, the 390px max-width mobile frame, inline-SVG nav icons, and emoji used as icons (🔥 🐾 🚨 ✨ 🐱).

The bottom nav marks 'Beranda' active on the stats screen, and its tab set differs from the other screens. It is also unclear how users reach this screen (it is not a tab here). It is probably reached from Beranda or Profil.
The table header says 'Total Jam' but the values are in minutes ('120m'). Rename the column to 'Durasi'.
Rounding: 11/12 = 91.67% is shown as '91.6%'. Use consistent rounding (91.7%).
Data is internally consistent: minutes sum to 840, sessions to 28, and flashcard buckets to 120 (matching 184 total minus drafts on daftar_flashcard).
The recall scale labels (Lupa Total/Agak Ragu/Ingat Baik/Mudah Sekali) differ from the review screen buttons (Ulangi/Sulit/Baik/Mudah). Unify them.

The stacked bar chart needs a custom Compose Canvas (or a chart library such as Vico). Bar height = minutes relative to the max day, segments = activity mix, with a label above. An accessible table alternative already exists in the design (Tabel toggle).
Mastery thresholds are inferred: Mastered >=90, Proficient ~80-89, Needs Practice ~50-79, Critical <50, N/A <5 items. They need product confirmation.
'Mulai Sesi Fokus' has no defined destination in any mockup.

sharedComponents.name: HeyMikaTheme (tokens)
sharedComponents.description: A Material3 ColorScheme plus extended colors from DESIGN.md. Ink navy #082A52, primary #0075E8 (button press shadow #005FC4), secondary/accent orange #FF8A00, brand-sky #16B5F5, brand-yellow #FFD34E, ribbon-red #EF3E36, badge-cyan #C5EFFF, canvas-bg #F8FCFF, border-muted #D8DDF4, text-muted #5868A4, danger #BC2535, danger-bg #FFF0F2, success #167549. Typography uses the Nunito Sans scale (display-hero-mobile 32/900, headline-lg-mobile 26/800, headline-md 24/800, headline-sm 20/700, body-lg/md/sm, label-lg/md/sm, caption). Shapes: 12–14dp controls, 28–32dp shells, pill. It replaces the current placeholder indigo/teal theme in :core/ui.

sharedComponents.name: HalftoneBackground
sharedComponents.description: Canvas #F8FCFF with a radial dot grid (sky/cyan dots on a 14–20dp grid at low opacity) and optional sparkle/star decorations kept to the edges. Implement with Modifier.drawBehind.

sharedComponents.name: ComicCard
sharedComponents.description: White surface with a 3dp #082A52 border and a hard #FF8A00 offset shadow (6dp on mobile, drawn as an offset shape behind, not elevation). Radius 28dp for shells and about 16dp for inner cards. Parameters: shadowOffset, borderWidth, radius, and a 'soft' variant (1.5dp #D8DDF4 border plus subtle ambient shadow) for utility cards. Login is the only mockup that uses the orange shadow.

sharedComponents.name: MikaSpeechBubble / MikaMascotCallout
sharedComponents.description: A Mika mascot image (pose enum: WAVING, WAVING_PENCIL, ENVELOPE, HAPPY, WORRIED; optional circular frame, halo/glow, sparkle badge) paired with a speech bubble: white or tinted surface, 16dp radius, a directional tail (Start, End or Bottom), an optional speaker label ('SAPAAN MIKA', 'Mika Sensei', 'MIKA • STUDY BUDDY'), a message, and an optional tip or caption. DESIGN.md asks for a 3dp navy border on the bubble and its tail.

sharedComponents.name: BrandHeroPill / BadgePill
sharedComponents.description: A fully rounded pill: badge-cyan background, navy uppercase label-sm text with tracking, and an optional leading icon (auto_awesome, security_update_good, emoji). Variants include edition pills ('VOL. 1 • ONBOARDING', 'VOL. 1 • EDISI BELAJAR'), section chips ('✨ PEMULIHAN KATA SANDI', 'SATU LANGKAH LAGI', 'QUEST GUARD LVL. 3'), the yellow 'PENDAMPING BELAJAR SETIA', and step chips ('Langkah 2 dari 2', 'LANGKAH 01 DARI 03').

sharedComponents.name: AuthTopBar
sharedComponents.description: A lightweight auth header (not a full TopAppBar) with slots. Leading: a back icon button or BackPill('Login' / 'DAFTAR AKUN BARU'). Center: the logo. Trailing: an action pill ('Bantuan') or a status pill. It respects status-bar insets. Do not reproduce the fake iOS status bar or home indicator.

sharedComponents.name: AuthHeader
sharedComponents.description: Title (headline-lg-mobile 26sp/800, navy) plus a text-muted subtitle, with optional alignment (center for login and verify, start elsewhere).

sharedComponents.name: HeyMikaTextField
sharedComponents.description: OutlinedTextField wrapper: 52–56dp tall, 12–14dp radius, white fill, 2dp #D8DDF4 border, and a 20dp leading icon in #5868A4. A label row has the label, an optional required asterisk and a right-aligned helper hint ('Disapa di dashboard', 'Verifikasi dikirim ke sini', 'Gunakan email terdaftar'). Focus: #0075E8 border plus a 3dp rgba(0,117,232,0.25) ring. Error: #BC2535 border, alert icon and #FFF0F2 callout. Supports KeyboardOptions and autofill content types.

sharedComponents.name: PasswordTextField
sharedComponents.description: HeyMikaTextField with a lock or lock_reset leading icon and a visibility / visibility_off trailing toggle. It has an optional trailing status label slot in the label row (strength label or match status).

sharedComponents.name: PasswordStrengthMeter + PasswordRequirementChecklist
sharedComponents.description: A 4-segment bar with a level label, plus a list of rules, each with a met or unmet icon. Layouts: List (register) or a 2x2 pill grid (reset). It should be driven by a single PasswordPolicy/PasswordStrengthCalculator use case in :core domain; the two mockups currently disagree on rules and labels.

sharedComponents.description: A rounded callout with an icon, a bold title and a description. Variants: Error (danger-bg #FFF0F2, #BC2535), Info (badge-cyan), Success (success/10), Warning (secondary-fixed). Used for login errors, verify status messages and reset notices.

sharedComponents.name: InfoNoteCard

sharedComponents.name: EmailSentConfirmation

sharedComponents.name: AuthResultStateCard
sharedComponents.description: A centered full-state card: icon or mascot in a tinted circle, status pill, headline-md title, body, optional mascot quote callout or XpRewardChip, a primary or accent CTA and an optional text action. Used for the expired-token, success and verified states.

sharedComponents.name: CountdownTimerPill
sharedComponents.description: A white pill with a pulsing green dot, a timer icon and an mm:ss countdown, for token expiry.

sharedComponents.name: XpRewardChip
sharedComponents.description: A row with a military_tech icon, a title and subtitle, and a '+N XP' pill. A related variant is the '+150 XP saat selesai' micro text in the onboarding header.

sharedComponents.name: AuthSwitchPrompt / LegalConsentText
sharedComponents.description: Centered muted text with a bold primary link ('Belum punya akun? Daftar sekarang', 'Sudah punya akun? Masuk di sini', 'Ingat password lamamu? Masuk di sini'). Legal text uses AnnotatedString with LinkAnnotation for Ketentuan Layanan and Kebijakan Privasi, plus a checkbox variant for register.

sharedComponents.name: HeyMikaCheckbox
sharedComponents.description: A 20dp rounded square with a 2dp navy border; checked state is a #0075E8 fill with a white check. It supports a multiline label with links.

sharedComponents.name: SelectableOptionCard / SegmentedPillSelector
sharedComponents.description: A radio-group option card (icon tile, title, subtitle, check badge, selected = solid primary fill) in a 2-column grid, and a 3-way segmented pill selector. Both are generic enough to reuse in later onboarding steps and in quiz configuration.

sharedComponents.name: HeyMikaSnackbar
sharedComponents.description: Toast-like snackbar: inverse surface #113059, rounded 16dp, a brand-yellow leading icon and a label-md message ('Berhasil masuk! Menyiapkan materi belajar Mika...', 'Percobaan login gagal!'). It replaces the HTML alert() and prompt() calls.

sharedComponents.name: HeyMikaTheme (tokens)
sharedComponents.description: Compose MaterialTheme built from DESIGN.md: brand blue #0075E8 (vs M3 primary #005ab5 used in three mockups), orange #FF8A00, sky #16B5F5, navy ink #082A52, canvas #F8FCFF, border-muted #D8DDF4, text-muted #5868A4, danger #BC2535 / danger-bg #FFF0F2, success #167549, badge-cyan #C5EFFF, brand-yellow #FFD34E, ribbon-red #EF3E36. Nunito Sans typography scale (display-hero-mobile 32/900 … caption 12/500). Shapes: card 16-32dp, controls 12-14dp, pills full. Plus custom extended tokens for comic border and offset shadow. Replaces the current placeholder indigo/teal theme in :core/ui/theme.

sharedComponents.name: Modifier.comicCard / ComicCard
sharedComponents.description: White surface with a 3px #082A52 border and a hard 6dp #FF8A00 offset shadow (drawBehind, no blur) per DESIGN.md, plus a 'subtle' variant (1.5px #D8DDF4 border and ambient lift) for utility/feed cards and a 'danger' variant (#BC2535 shadow). The mockups use the subtle variant almost everywhere; Profil uses an orange offset with no border.

sharedComponents.name: HeyMikaButton (Primary / Accent / Tonal / Outline / Danger / Text)
sharedComponents.description: Pressable buttons with a hard bottom shadow (4dp darker shade) that translate down 2dp on press (150ms). Primary blue, Accent orange (DESIGN: 3px navy outline), Tonal surface-container, Outline white with border, Danger red. 56dp height for main CTAs; compact variants used in cards. Optional leading icon/emoji.

sharedComponents.name: HeyMikaTopBar
sharedComponents.description: App bar with the HeyMika logo (mascot head + wordmark), optional title/subtitle + level pill, StreakPill, NotificationBellButton with an unread dot, and UserAvatar. Variants: home (logo only), titled (Notifikasi/Profil), back (system states / pushed screens).

sharedComponents.name: StreakPill / LevelPill / TokenPill
sharedComponents.description: Small rounded status pills: fire icon + 'N Hari'; 'Lv.N' / 'Level N • title'; bolt + token balance; focus mode pill.

sharedComponents.name: HeyMikaBottomNavBar
sharedComponents.description: 5-tab bottom navigation with an active blue state and an orange badge dot on Tanya Mika. Tab set, order, labels and icons differ between mockups (Beranda/Materi/Kuis/Tanya Mika/Profil vs Beranda/Materimu/Tanya Mika/Kuis/Akun), so define one canonical version. Hosts top-level destinations; dynamic-feature tabs need install handling.

sharedComponents.name: MikaSpeechBubble / MikaCallout
sharedComponents.description: Mika mascot image or icon tile beside a quote. DESIGN.md: white bubble, 3px navy border, 16dp radius, bordered directional tail. Variants: hero recommendation (Beranda), tip card with toggles (Notifikasi), guide card (Profil), error speech with an upward tail (System States). Optional StickerPill ('GANBATTE! 🐾', 'nyaa~', 'AI').

sharedComponents.name: FilterChipRow / PillTabRow
sharedComponents.description: Horizontally scrolling single-select pill chips (active = primary fill). Recent-material filter, notification categories, error-state selector, profile anchor tabs.

sharedComponents.name: SegmentedControl

sharedComponents.name: CategoryTag / SubjectTag

sharedComponents.name: LabeledProgressBar / QuotaUsageMeter
sharedComponents.description: Label + value row over a rounded linear bar (blue/orange, an unlimited variant at 100%). Material progress, AI quota usage, plan quotas.

sharedComponents.name: CircularProgressRing

sharedComponents.name: ToggleRow

sharedComponents.name: HeyMikaSearchField
sharedComponents.description: Rounded search input with a leading search icon and a trailing mic icon or attached 'Cari' button.

sharedComponents.name: HeyMikaTextField / PasswordField / TextArea
sharedComponents.description: Inputs with a leading icon, helper/error text, focus ring (#0075E8) and error state (#BC2535 + #FFF0F2 callout). The password variant has a visibility toggle and a strength meter. Shared with the auth screens (login/register/reset).

sharedComponents.name: SectionHeader / NumberedSectionHeader / DateGroupHeader
sharedComponents.description: Section title rows: tag + title + trailing count (Beranda), numbered badge + title + trailing pill (Profil), dot + uppercase label + hairline (notification date groups), title + count pill (System catalog).

sharedComponents.name: InfoNoteCard / InfoCallout
sharedComponents.description: Tinted card with a leading icon, bold title and body for reassurance/principles notes (data safety, error principles, email verification notice).

sharedComponents.name: SelectableOptionCard

sharedComponents.name: HeyMikaSnackbar / Toast

Pressed state translates down 2dp and shrinks the shadow to 2dp. Supports leading and trailing icons.

sharedComponents.name: MikaSpeechCard / MikaSpeechBubble
sharedComponents.description: Mascot callout: Mika avatar (rounded square or circle, with an optional corner badge such as ★, 'AI' or 'TUTOR AI') next to a speech bubble with a 3px navy border, 16dp radius and directional tail. Body is an AnnotatedString with highlighted spans (primary/ribbon-red/bold). Optional title row, chip row and halftone decoration. Also used compact for the hint drawer and the encouragement banner (with LevelBadge).

sharedComponents.name: StatTile
sharedComponents.description: Compact metric tile for 2x2 grids: icon in a tinted square, caption label, headline value plus unit, optional status/delta chip (top-right), optional caption line or progress bar, and a tone (neutral/danger/success/orange/primary). The rencana variant is comic-bordered.

sharedComponents.name: BrandHeroPill / StatusPill / SubjectTag
sharedComponents.description: Fully rounded chips. BrandHeroPill is badge-cyan with a sparkle icon and uppercase text (e.g. 'Adaptive Scheduler v2.4', 'Transparansi Belajar', 'KONSEP INTI • GRAF'). StatusPill has a live dot (e.g. 'Optimal', 'Auto-Sync Aktif'). SubjectTag and DueChip are light tint with saturated ink, colored by subject or urgency. CountPill is '8 Deck'.

sharedComponents.name: SegmentedProgressBar
sharedComponents.description: Multi-segment horizontal bar (rounded track) taking a list of (fraction, color) pairs. Used for review session rating mix, flashcard recall distribution and progress bars.

sharedComponents.name: LinearMeter / RetentionProgressBar
sharedComponents.description: Single-value progress bar with color chosen by threshold band (success/primary/orange/danger/grey), plus label and percentage text. Used for deck retention, topic mastery and daily target.

sharedComponents.name: SegmentedToggle
sharedComponents.description: Pill track with equal-width options and one selected (white raised segment, primary text). Used for 7/30/90 Hari and Grafik/Tabel.

sharedComponents.name: FilterChipRow
sharedComponents.description: Horizontally scrolling LazyRow of pill filter chips with an optional count badge. The selected chip is primary-filled.

sharedComponents.name: ExpandableSection (Accordion)
sharedComponents.description: Header row with icon/title/subtitle and a rotating caret that expands content with animation. Used for the Mika hint drawer and the integrity rules list.

sharedComponents.name: SrsRatingGrid
sharedComponents.description: 2x2 grid of recall rating buttons (AGAIN/HARD/GOOD/EASY), each showing a label, interval preview and sublabel, tinted by rating. It drives the scheduler and needs one Rating enum shared with stats.

sharedComponents.name: FlashcardDeckCard
sharedComponents.description: Deck list item with subject tag, due/completed chip, title, overflow menu, retention panel (meter, card count, average interval or next due) and footer (last studied plus 'Mulai Review' or 'Ulangi Opsional').

sharedComponents.name: StudyTaskCard
sharedComponents.description: Planner task card: type chip (Bank Kesalahan / Interval n Hari), course label, duration chip, title, description, status row (urgency, progress, target/memory level) and primary or outline CTA routed by task type.

sharedComponents.name: WeekDayStrip / DayChip
sharedComponents.description: 7-day selectable strip with DayChip states DONE (check), TODAY (primary fill, progress mini-chip), PLANNED (dot), BOOSTED (+15m orange tint), REST (grey dot). It must fit at 360dp width or scroll.

sharedComponents.name: TopicMasteryCard / PriorityTopicCard
sharedComponents.description: Topic-level performance cards: level badge, title, 'X soal selesai • Y benar', large percent, meter and tone-colored CTA. The priority variant is a tinted carousel card with two actions (practice and discuss/review).

sharedComponents.name: StackedBarChart
sharedComponents.description: Custom Canvas weekly chart with stacked segments per day (Kuis/Catatan/Flashcard), a value label above each bar, weekday labels and a legend. A table alternative is provided by the toggle.

sharedComponents.name: RadialProgress
sharedComponents.description: Small circular progress ring with a centered percent label (weekly goal).

sharedComponents.name: AskMikaInputBar
sharedComponents.description: Floating input bar above the bottom nav with Mika avatar, text field and orange send button. It opens the tutor conversation with the typed prompt.

sharedComponents.name: SearchField
sharedComponents.description: 48-56dp rounded input with a leading search icon, placeholder and trailing filter (tune) action. Follows the DESIGN.md input spec (2px #D8DDF4 border, blue focus ring).

sharedComponents.name: HalftoneDecoration
sharedComponents.description: Decorative screentone dot pattern or dashed circle placed in card corners (non-interactive, low opacity).

sharedComponents.name: HeyMikaPrimaryButton
sharedComponents.description: 56dp full-width primary-blue CTA with leading/trailing icons and a loading state ("Mengunci Transaksi..."). Per DESIGN.md it should have a 14dp radius, a 4dp #005FC4 base shadow and a 2dp press translate. Both mockups use a soft shadow instead.

sharedComponents.name: HeyMikaTonalButton
sharedComponents.description: Secondary surface-container filled button ("Terapkan", "Chat CS", "Unduh Invoice PDF", "Bantuan") with an optional icon. DESIGN.md's secondary button spec is white with a 2dp navy border, so confirm which to use.

sharedComponents.name: ProfileAvatarButton
sharedComponents.description: 32dp circular primary avatar with the person icon (or initials) at the right of the top bar

sharedComponents.name: BadgePill / StatusPill
sharedComponents.description: Fully rounded pill with optional leading icon and color variants: cyan (badge-cyan) brand/info, peach (secondary-fixed) period/method, yellow (brand-yellow) reward/popular, success/10 green guarantee, danger-bg danger, surface-container-high neutral. Used for "256-Bit SSL", "PRO", "Hemat 15%", "+500 Koin AI", "Terverifikasi", "12 Bulan Akses", "Garansi 7 Hari", "TERVERIFIKASI RESMI", "Lunas via QRIS", "Paket Populer", "Idempotent Safe".

sharedComponents.name: MikaAvatar
sharedComponents.description: Circular mascot avatar (48/64/80dp) on a tinted background (peach or yellow) using a bundled Mika cat asset

sharedComponents.name: MikaSpeechBubble
sharedComponents.description: White bubble hosting Mika dialogue, with an optional label ("PESAN SAHABAT MIKA"), quote text, signature/footer and directional tail. DESIGN.md requires a 3dp navy border, 16dp radius and a tail; neither mock fully complies.

sharedComponents.name: PriceBreakdown / PriceRow
sharedComponents.description: Bill summary rows (label with optional info icon, then value) with variants for normal, discount (green, negative), free (green uppercase) and tax, followed by a divider and a GrandTotalRow (label + caption + large primary amount). It formats IDR as "Rp 542.790" (id-ID locale).

sharedComponents.name: NumberedCircleBadge
sharedComponents.description: Small colored circle with a number, used for checkout section headers (1, 2) and status next-step items (1 blue, 2 orange, 3 sky)

sharedComponents.name: HeyMikaCard (ComicCard)
sharedComponents.description: Base white rounded content card. DESIGN.md spec: 3dp #082A52 border plus a 6dp hard #FF8A00 offset shadow on mobile and a 28-32dp radius for large shells. The mocks use 12-16dp radii with soft shadows; it needs a variant parameter (comic vs subtle).

sharedComponents.name: InfoCallout / TrustChecklistItem
sharedComponents.description: Icon (green check/verified/lock) with bold title and body text on a tinted surface. Used for the voucher-applied banner, trust rows and the webhook verification callout.

sharedComponents.name: SupportEntry (WhatsApp CS)
sharedComponents.description: Launches the external WhatsApp CS chat. It is the "Chat CS" card on checkout and the "Bantuan" button on status.

sharedComponents.name: StickyBottomActionBar
sharedComponents.description: Translucent white bottom dock with an upward shadow and safe-area padding, holding the summary and CTA(s). Scroll content needs bottom padding equal to its height.

sharedComponents.name: SelectableOptionCard (radio card)
sharedComponents.description: Card with a leading radio, title, badges, caption and trailing content (price or icon), in selected/unselected states. Used for plan periods and payment methods. DESIGN.md radio: 20dp circle, 2dp navy border, primary fill when checked.

sharedComponents.name: HalftoneDotsDecoration
sharedComponents.description: Decorative manga halftone dot grid (Canvas-drawn) placed in card corners at about 25% opacity
